patch_description: Reorganizes the search around a small scored archive and independently tracked move operators. Each iteration selects an archive parent, allocates proposal effort using operator-specific outcomes and stall signals, then screens a small batch by surrogate energy and LP-scores it. This keeps the neighborhood generators separate and avoids spending most of the budget on large, repeatedly unproductive batches, while retaining bottleneck-focused swaps, rotations, and multi-switch kicks for diversification.
